name: Changelog Rail
summary: A vertical tab docked to a screen edge that opens the changelog.
description: A narrow strip that sits flush against one side of the screen, with its label rotated to read bottom-to-top like a spine. Only the two corners facing into the page round off — the two flush against the screen edge stay square, since there's nothing on the other side for a curve to read against.
whenToUse: Giving a screen a persistent way to open its changelog
Docking a labeled tab to the left or right edge of a layout
whenNotToUse: Placing a tab anywhere but a screen edge — this only makes sense flush against one
Needing more than a single short label — this isn't built to hold a menu

side.left: Docks to the screen's left edge. Corners round on the right, facing into the page.
side.right: Docks to the screen's right edge. Corners round on the left, facing into the page.

dos: Match the side prop to whichever physical edge it's docked against.
Give it an explicit height in any container that doesn't already have one.
donts: Don't dock it away from a real screen edge. Its square corners assume one.
Don't leave height unset in an unsized wrapper. It collapses to an unreadable stub.

keyboard: Enter / Space activates, same as any button
notes: The label text doubles as its accessible name — keep it short enough to stay legible rotated on its side.

states.focus: A thick outline appears around the rail for keyboard focus.
